title: Decision Feedback Equalizer
text: Equalize modulated signals using decision feedback filtering, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Adaptive algorithm} sets Adaptive algorithm; {Number of forward taps} sets the number of forward equalizer taps, {Number of feedback taps} sets the number of feedback equalizer taps, {Signal constellation}, {Number of input samples per symbol}, {Step size}, {Forgetting factor}, {Initial inverse correlation matrix}, {Reference tap}, {Input signal delay (samples)}, {Source of adapt weights flag} sets the source of adapt tap weights request, {Adapt tap weights}, {Initial tap weights source} sets the source for initial tap weights, {Initial weights} sets the initial tap weights, {Tap weight update period (symbols)}, {Enable training control input}, {Update tap weights when not training}, {Enable reset input}, {Info} sets the decision feedback equalizer information, {Output error signal} enables error signal output, {Output taps weights} enables tap weights output and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of forward taps
params.values: Number of forward equalizer taps 5 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of feedback taps
params.values: Number of feedback equalizer taps 3 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Signal constellation
params.values: Signal constellation pskmod(0:3,4,pi/4) (default) | vector

params.name: Number of input samples per symbol
params.values: Number of input samples per symbol 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Adaptive algorithm
params.values: Adaptive algorithm LMS (default) | RLS | CMA

params.name: Step size
params.values: Step size 0.01 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Forgetting factor
params.values: Forgetting factor 0.99 (default) | scalar in the range (0, 1]

params.name: Initial inverse correlation matrix
params.values: Initial inverse correlation matrix 0.1 (default) | scalar | matrix

params.name: Reference tap
params.values: Reference tap 3 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Input signal delay (samples)
params.values: Input signal delay 0 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Source of adapt weights flag
params.values: Source of adapt tap weights request Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Adapt tap weights
params.values: Adapt tap weights on (default) | off

params.name: Initial tap weights source
params.values: Source for initial tap weights Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Initial weights
params.values: Initial tap weights 0 or [0;0;1;0;0] (default) | scalar | column vector

params.name: Tap weight update period (symbols)
params.values: Tap weight update period 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable training control input
params.values: Enable training control input off (default) | on

params.name: Update tap weights when not training
params.values: Update tap weights when not training on (default) | off

params.name: Enable reset input
params.values: Enable reset input off (default) | on

params.name: Info
params.values: Decision feedback equalizer information button

params.name: Output error signal
params.values: Enable error signal output off (default) | on

params.name: Output taps weights
params.values: Enable tap weights output off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
